item.tib: zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus thos chog rang grol chen po'i rgyud las dbang khrid rang gsal ye shes 'od kyi 'khor lo
item.coloph: zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus thos chog rang grol chen po'i rgyud las / dbang khrid [182v1] rang gsal ye shes 'od kyi 'khor lo 'di ni / dmu rigs rgyal gyi gdung rgyud chen po gshen lhun grub rgya mtsho'i gsung gis bskul te / dus snyigs ma'i kho bo smon rgyal kun grol grags pa nam mkha' ngang tshul zhes bya bas / 'gal byed kyi mo 'du byed zla ba'i dkar phyogs la / khyi za rma lha mched gsum gyi mdun zhol / gdan sa chen po steng chen rnam rgyal gling mgon du grub pa bgyid pa / yi ge pa ni sdom brtson gtsug phud 'od zer gyis byas … khro chen rgyal po'i par du bsgrub pa 'dir / gnam lo sa byi bon bstan dan rgyug tshe / hor zla drug gi tshes bzhi dge ba ru / smon rgyal sangs rin ming gis dag zhus bgyis

item.tib: zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus thos chog rang grol chen po'i rgyud las dbang khrid rang gsal ye shes 'od kyi 'khor lo
item.coloph: ces zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus thos chog rang grol chen po'i rgyad las/ dbang khrid rang gsal ye shes 'od kyi 'khor lo 'di/ dmu rigs rgyal gyi gdung rgyud chen po gshen lhun grub rgya mtsho'i gsung gi (gis) bskul te/ dus snyigs ma'i kho bo smon rgyal kun grol grags pa nam mkha'i ngang tshul can zhes bya bas/ 'gal byed lo 'du byed zla ba'i dkar phyogs la/ gyi za rma lha mched gsum mdun zhol gdan sa chen po steng rnam rgyal gling dgon du grub par bgyis/ yi ge pa ni sdom brtson gtsug phud 'od zer gyis byas pa 'dis kyang / bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig/
